task: Caption conditional on provided human region crop; separate from learned region detection
image_coordinates: raw decoded VG RGB, no EXIF transpose; dimensions must agree with audited pixel metadata
eligibility: positive finite width/height, finite nonnegative x/y, fully contained original box, nonempty original human phrase
pixel_crop: half-open xyxy: floor(left/top),ceil(right/bottom); no clipping, resizing or score-based crop selection
identity: positive integer image_id and region_id; region image_id must equal parent; duplicate region IDs are fatal including ineligible rows
evaluation_unit: vg:image_id:region:region_id; one unchanged nonempty human phrase as reference; no image-level reference pooling or implicit paraphrases
duplicate_geometry: different region IDs retain separate annotated units; no unregistered merging or choosing references
invalid_rows: enumerate reason and keep total counts; eligibility applied before predictions, never drop a valid unit due to missing prediction
input_boundary: model input has only provided crop geometry and identity; reference text is separate evaluation-only mapping
metric_units: native corpus pycocoevalcap over complete locked eligible unit set; paired bootstrap by parent image, retaining every selected region of each sampled image
claims: provided-crop results do not demonstrate automatic region localization; learned region matching/coverage/no-match penalties require a separate protocol
evaluation_admission_remaining: Full source schema and geometry eligibility audit with audited image dimensions

Explicit development/test memberships and workload resource admission before generation
Matched graph-to-text controls and independent dev prompt lock
